UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: The public profile of a user in the Zone.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user.

username.description: The display name of the user.

level.description: The current level of the user.

xp.description: The current XP of the user.

totalXp.description: The total accumulated XP of the user.

equippedFrame.description: The ID of the currently equipped profile frame.

equippedTitle.description: The ID of the currently equipped title.

profilePicture.description: The URL of the user's profile picture.

streak.description: The current daily streak of the user.

badgesCount.description: The number of badges unlocked by the user.

framesCount.description: The number of frames unlocked by the user.

missionsCompleted.description: The total number of missions completed by the user.

isProfilePublic.description: Whether the user's profile is visible on the global leaderboard.

ovr.description: The overall rating of the user.

missionAffinity.description: Weights for mission categories based on user behavior.

lastActive.description: The timestamp of the user's last activity.

Mission.description: A mission template that can be assigned to users.
